experiment_data.hypothesis: Few-shot demonstrations (1-shot and 5-shot) reduce the BCS-driven confusability effect (high-BCS accuracy penalty) by grounding type boundaries through explicit examples, tested on extreme-BCS batches (low ~0.36, high ~0.80) where 0-shot delta is ~25-31pp. If delta shrinks significantly under few-shot, confusability is addressable via prompting. If delta persists, confusability is a fundamental schema-structural constraint.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/bin/activate base && cd /root/schema-dag-extraction && python3 src/run_fewshot_bcs_v2.py --stage all --n_shots 0 1 5 --seed 42"
spec.data_count: 50 batches (25 low-BCS ~0.36, 25 high-BCS ~0.80) x 3 shots = 450 tasks
